description: Real Monkey's Audio files of versions before 3.99 from the FFmpeg sample archive, which the SDK 13.42 can decode and not write, so they are the only encoder-made reference for the coding of those versions (the legacy-* fixtures are written by monkeys_audio_legacy.py and held to the SDK's decoder instead). None may be redistributed here, so they are downloaded and checked against their SHA-256 rather than committed. Per file: what mac 13.42 (mac -V verifies every frame CRC, mac -d gives the samples), ffmpeg, ffprobe and MediaInfo must report, and what the analyzer must report with --verify. The archive holds one more file of 3.97 (archive/audio/ape, 244 MB, level high), too large to download on every run, and the rest of its Monkey's Audio files are version 3.99.

ffmpeg.terms: The FFmpeg sample archive's 00-README: "You are free to download any samples you want". They are downloaded and checked, not committed.
